name: SNK Neo Geo (AES/MVS/CD)
_notes: A/B on the bottom row (south/east) and C/D on top (west/north), FBNeo's 'classic' Neo Geo pad layout. The other common choice follows the MVS straight row / AES arc: A/B/C/D = face_west/face_south/face_east/face_north. [VERIFY] the EmuDeck/FBNeo default. select is the AES select button and the MVS coin; FBNeo maps coin to RetroPad Select.
